measurement: Each variant restores original shader Resource objects from that batch's actual pre-refresh snapshot. Scene creation, shader restoration, full verification scans, parameter inspection, and retirement are outside timed calls. Candidate includes queueing and external flush-call duration. Entrant nodes that were created then freed during atomic construction are absent from the settled snapshot; this compares the live material work, not construction-time node-added callback overhead.
scope: Actual production Expanded PoolWorld/RoomBuilder/PoolMaterials, unchanged baseline synchronous shells, exact old material scan versus incremental queue on the same live scene and material IDs. Eight alternating repetitions per real shell/interior batch. CPU-headless only; no water, lights/probes, GPU RT, DLSS/FG or game frame-time claim.
